name: How long does a storm damage assessment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a storm damage assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard storm damage assessment typically takes about 30 minutes to an hour, depending on the size and complexity of your roof and the visible damage. Our goal is to provide a comprehensive evaluation without prolonged disruption. We aim to provide a detailed report and recommendations within 24-48 hours after the inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Assessments usually take 30-60 minutes, varying by roof size, with detailed reports provided within 1-2 days.
